notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0): only the "Table of Contents" subpage exists; "Walkthrough", "Gameplay", "Controls", "Enemies" and "Achievements and trophies" are linked but not written, so nothing was used. lostsoulaside.fandom.com does not exist (HTTP 404); lost-soul-aside.fandom.com answers the API with a "Lost Soul Aside" page that has no linked pages, and the whole wiki lists only 13 pages (such as "Kaser", "Louisa" and "World"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 3378960 is "Lost Soul Aside™". None of the 37 Steam achievements is hidden. The story chapters use the prologue and chapter part names given in the achievement descriptions; "Complete your first adventure" is placed with Chapter 4, the last chapter the achievements name. Many completion goals have very low unlock rates (about 2 to 8%).
